title: Austurian Tree Cabage - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Rare Tall Cabbage
description:
Discover the incredible Asturian Tree Cabbage, a robust and long-lived brassica perfect for your garden or food forest. Originating from northern Spain, this perennial vegetable thrives in cool, damp climates, making it exceptionally well-suited to the UK. Unlike annual cabbages, it forms a woody stem over time, producing abundant, tender leaves that can be harvested repeatedly throughout the year.

Asturian Tree Cabbage is a fantastic addition for gardeners seeking resilient, long-term crops. Its large, emerald green leaves have a mild, slightly sweet cabbage flavour, delicious raw when young or cooked in a variety of dishes. Regular harvesting encourages fresh growth and maintains plant vigour. It's also known for its good resistance to caterpillar damage.

These mini plug plants offer a fantastic start to growing your own continuous supply of fresh greens. They establish well and will provide years of delicious harvests with minimal fuss. A true permaculture gem!
